title: lithocarpus kemmaratensis
intro: Lithocarpus kemmaratensis, commonly known as Thai Oak, is a plant species in the beech family (Fagaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lithocarpus kemmaratensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
